intro.fr: EarthBound Beginnings, le premier Mother, a un randomizer depuis 2014 et se joue en multiworld Archipelago via un APWorld communautaire.
intro.en: EarthBound Beginnings, the first Mother, has had a randomizer since 2014 and can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld.

text.fr: Ape sort Mother sur Famicom en 1989 ; il sort en Occident en 2015 sous le nom EarthBound Beginnings.
text.en: Ape releases Mother on the Famicom in 1989; it comes out in the West in 2015 as EarthBound Beginnings.

text.fr: L'EarthBound Zero Randomizer, conçu pour la fête des 25 ans de Mother, est publié sur le forum Starmen.Net et mis à jour en septembre 2014 puis en mars 2015 ; rando-list l'attribue à Agent Ape. Il mélange la version NES et s'inspire du Reshuffler d'EarthBound de Tomato.
text.en: The EarthBound Zero Randomizer, made for the Mother 25th Anniversary fanfest, is posted on the Starmen.Net forum and updated in September 2014 and March 2015; rando-list credits it to Agent Ape. It shuffles the NES version and is inspired by Tomato's EarthBound Reshuffler.

text.fr: Un APWorld de Mother (EarthBound Beginnings) est distribué depuis juin 2025 sur le serveur Discord d'Archipelago, où son fil est ouvert le 14 juin 2025.
text.en: A Mother (EarthBound Beginnings) APWorld has been distributed since June 2025 on the Archipelago Discord server, where its thread opens on June 14, 2025.
